paper_or_case_title: A mitochondrial ferredoxin is essential for biogenesis of cellular iron-sulfur proteins
reported_issue: PNAS correction states that the thermoprinter-paper Western-blot printout was cut into pieces and reassembled because gel loading did not match the desired presentation order; the published panel also contained an unintentional mirrored duplication of the 64 h bands.
results_sentence: A PNAS correction documents cut-and-reassembled Leu1p Western-blot lanes and a mirrored duplication in a direct S. cerevisiae experiment, mapping this audit precedent to the approximately 86 kDa neighborhood.
species_interpretation: direct S. cerevisiae case; 85.8 kDa is the current SGD sequence-derived Leu1p mass; correction reports an assembly error and states overall results were not impacted

paper_or_case_title: Membrane expansion alleviates endoplasmic reticulum stress independently of the unfolded protein response
reported_protein_claim: Rtn1-Cherry western blot detected through the Cherry tag
reported_issue: JCB correction states that Fig. 7A was assembled incorrectly, resulting in inadvertent duplication of lanes showing Rtn1 in DTT-treated cells.
results_sentence: A JCB correction documents duplicated Rtn1-Cherry lanes in a direct S. cerevisiae Western blot, providing an audit precedent around the roughly 60 kDa fusion-protein neighborhood.
species_interpretation: direct S. cerevisiae case; 59.6 kDa is an estimated theoretical fusion mass from SGD Rtn1 (32.9 kDa) plus mCherry (26.7 kDa), not a reported apparent band mass

paper_or_case_title: Membrane expansion alleviates endoplasmic reticulum stress independently of the unfolded protein response
reported_issue: JCB correction states that Fig. 7A was assembled incorrectly, resulting in mislabeling of the lanes showing the Pgk1 loading control.
results_sentence: The same JCB correction documents mislabeled Pgk1 loading-control lanes in a direct S. cerevisiae Western blot, mapping the corrected control to the approximately 45 kDa neighborhood.
species_interpretation: direct S. cerevisiae case; 44.7 kDa is the current SGD sequence-derived Pgk1 mass; correction states interpretation was unchanged
